full_judgment: 14. The High Court Division was of the view that no public witness was examined over the recovery of the arms. It is now settled that a public servant while discharging public duty seizes any contraband goods or article from a person, it will be presumed that he has acted in accordance with law. It is a presumption of fact. If the recovery and seizure are made in accordance with law, it is difficult to disbelieve the evidence of the seizing officer unless inherent infirmities are revealed in course of cross-examination. Therefore, the onus lies upon the accused to show that no such arm was recovered from his possession.
